input.sql: SELECT pid, name, memory_usage FROM processes ORDER BY memory_usage DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT * FROM pg_stat_activity ORDER BY memory DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT pid, name, memory FROM processes ORDER BY memory DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT pid, usename AS name, pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(datname)) AS memory FROM pg_stat_activity ORDER BY pg_total_relation_size(datname) DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT pid, usename AS name, pg_size_pretty(pg_database_size(datname)) AS memory FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname IS NOT NULL ORDER BY pg_database_size(datname) DESC LIMIT 5;
